stepNotes.1: Single-file yargs command module exporting AcpCommand at acp.ts:9; registered in boot.ts:61 alongside ~50 sibling commands; heavy ACP/Server/SDK imports are lazy-loaded inside the handler (acp.ts:20-23) to keep cold start cheap.
stepNotes.2: Loopback-only enforcement lives in network.ts:71-80 (hard-rejects non-loopback --hostname, --cors, and any --mdns); no secrets or env values logged, only signal name and caught errors at acp.ts:33-35/94.
stepNotes.3: bootstrap wraps body in Instance dispose (bootstrap.ts:4-17); stopping guard at acp.ts:28/31 is sound; defect: SIGINT/SIGTERM listeners registered at acp.ts:46-47 are only detached in finally at acp.ts:91-92, so a throw from Server.listen/createAxCodeClient/ACP.init leaks them.
stepNotes.4: WritableStream/ReadableStream pair at acp.ts:53-74 adapts Node stdio to ndJsonStream; stdin data/end/error listeners attached at acp.ts:68-72 and 87-88 are not removed in the finally (acp.ts:90-96) — masked by process.exit(0) on signal path but observable on graceful stdin-EOF.
stepNotes.5: Single-threaded event loop makes the boolean stopping guard at acp.ts:31 sufficient; void shutdown(...) at acp.ts:41/44 cannot produce unhandled rejection because server.stop(true).catch swallows internally (acp.ts:34-36).
stepNotes.6: Thin wiring module delegates ACP semantics to ACP.init/agent.create (acp.ts:77,80) and HTTP to Server.listen/stop; the dropped AgentSideConnection return at acp.ts:79-81 is idiomatic for the SDK constructor which self-registers on the stream.
stepNotes.7: No empty catches, TODOs, or commented code; the one hygiene defect is the dead --cwd yargs option (acp.ts:13-17) silently ignored because the handler calls bootstrap(process.cwd(), ...) at acp.ts:25 instead of args.cwd.
stepNotes.8: Only acp.test.ts:5-10 covers this file, asserting createAxCodeClient naming via raw text read — pure rename guard; the seven test/acp/*.test.ts files exercise @/acp/agent, not this entrypoint, so the --cwd defect and shutdown path have no behavioral coverage.
stepNotes.9: Three findings accepted: MEDIUM dead --cwd option (acp.ts:13-17 vs 25), LOW signal-listener leak on early failure (acp.ts:46-47 vs 91-92), LOW stdin listeners never detached (acp.ts:68-72); no Critical items so no reverify.md required.
